description: Performance budgets enforced by perf and integration smoke tests. The inline assertion in each test is the source of truth; this file is the human-readable index. Update both together when a budget changes.

budgets.name: Sustained runner retained bytes per stream
budgets.rationale: Keeps stdout and stderr parser memory bounded independently while raw capture remains complete. Raised from 4 MiB on 2026-08-16 after a single planning phase emitted 4.8 MiB and was failed on output volume; the classification amplifier that made the old number a memory constraint was removed from stream-json-unwrapper.ts in the same change

budgets.name: Large phase-log hydrated entry cap
budgets.rationale: Bounds projected phase-log state while retaining the newest ordered entries

budgets.name: project() at the PERMITTED queue scale — 20 queues x 100 pending = 2,000 items
budgets.rationale: FR-R3-114 row 1 — every other render case measured 25 items while the product permits 2,000 (MAX_QUEUES x 100). Measured 2026-08-27 on darwin/arm64: 649.8 ms total for 100 passes, median 6.39 ms. Budget is ~3x the measurement: headroom for a loaded machine, tight enough to catch an order-of-magnitude regression. Companion median budget PERMITTED_SCALE_MEDIAN_BUDGET_MS = 20 ms.

notes: All budgets are wall-clock milliseconds measured via performance.now().
Items 048 and 053 (deferred refactors) MAY adjust the StateProjector totals; reset budgets accordingly when those land.
Item 050 (second BackendRunner adapter, deferred) does not affect any budget.
